title: eDM HTML Builder
description: Visual, module-based builder I made at Dentsu to speed up producing HTML emails (eDMs) for American Express — no more hand-coding each campaign from scratch. Pick modules from a reusable library, fill in copy/images/colours through auto-generated forms, and preview live on desktop and mobile before exporting or saving the campaign.
challenge: Hand-coding every Amex eDM from scratch made campaign production slow and error-prone, especially wrangling Outlook/MSO quirks over and over.
technique: Built a PHP/MySQL, database-driven module library — headers, footers, hero banners, feature grids, step guides, an interactive kinetic carousel — so campaigns are assembled by picking modules and filling in auto-generated forms, with live desktop/mobile preview and a full HTML source view. New module types can be added by editing seed data alone, with no UI code changes required.
outcome: Turned eDM production into a fill-in-the-blanks process, with Outlook-safe markup (conditional table wrapping, VML buttons, VML background overlays) baked into every module, cutting build time on repeat Amex campaigns.
